name: Oyako x Shuffle! ~Natsuyasumi, W Oyako no Icha Icha Houimou~
original_name: 母娘×シャッフル！～夏休み、Ｗ母娘のいちゃいちゃ包囲網～
source:
The protagonist, Hirosawa Yuuya, started living alone for university entrance. Last year, he didn't return home even once due to the busyness of his new life. However, he decided to return at the request of his sister, Hirosawa Miu, who asked him to be her tutor.
Upon returning home, his mother, Hirosawa Ayano, who had always been overly affectionate, became even more so due to the long-awaited reunion with her son. In addition, his aunt, Aoyama Reika, who is in the middle of a quarrel with her husband and returning home, and her daughter, Aoyama Rio, greet him.
His mother's affectionate pampering, his sister's proactive approach, his mischievous aunt, and his aunt's daughter who admires her big brother.
Under one roof with such four people, a lovey-dovey, naughty, and shuffled harem life was about to begin with 'mother x sister', 'sister x cousin', 'aunt x mother', and 'aunt x cousin'.
translation:
主人公广泽悠也为了考大学开始了独居生活。去年，由于新生活的忙碌，他一次也没回家。然而，在妹妹广泽美宇的要求下，他决定回来，并请他担任她的家庭教师。
回到家后，一向过于慈爱的母亲广泽绫野，因与儿子久别重逢而变得更加慈爱。此外，正在与丈夫吵架回家的姨妈青山丽华和女儿青山理央也前来迎接。
母亲的深情宠爱，妹妹的主动靠近，调皮捣蛋的姑姑，还有仰慕哥哥的姑姑女儿。
四人同在一个屋檐下，一场“妈妈×妹妹”、“姐姐×表弟”、“姨妈×妈妈”、“姨妈×表弟”的恩爱、顽皮、洗牌的后宫生活即将开始。
